title: Plugin
description: Canonical Plugin contract per DEVOS-SPEC-026. Plugins extend DevOS through declared public interfaces only; undeclared capabilities do not exist at runtime.

id.description: Stable Plugin identifier unique inside the owning Workspace.

version.description: Plugin version within its compatibility range, per DEVOS-SPEC-059.

compatibility.description: Supported platform version range; absent or unparseable ranges are invalid and rejected per DEVOS-SPEC-059.

items.description: Scoped capability string following the grammar '<domain>:<capability>' with optional ':<scope-pattern>'.

permissions.description: Requested capabilities evaluated deny-by-default by the Security Engine per DEVOS-SPEC-036.

contributions.description: Declared contribution points taking effect only while the Plugin is Enabled, withdrawn atomically on disable or delete per DEVOS-SPEC-032.

descriptor.description: Binding-defined pointer to the enablement logic.

entry.description: Entry descriptor locating the plugin enablement logic.

hookPoint.description: Named hook point per DEVOS-SPEC-056; unknown interfaces cause rejection at enable time.

topicPattern.description: Topic pattern over the lowercase dotted convention of DEVOS-SPEC-037.
